brief_title: Primary (Familial and Non-familial) Hypercholesterolemia or Mixed Hyperlipidemia Characterized by Elevated LDL-C
official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase II Clinical Trial Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of YKYY015 Injection at Different Doses in Participants With Primary Hypercholesterolemia or Mixed Hyperlipidemia and Elevated LDL-C Inadequately Controlled on Statin Therapy

lead_sponsor.name: Youcare Pharmaceutical Group Hangzhou Tianlong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

primary_outcomes.measure: The percentage change (percent)in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) from the baseline at Day180.

brief_summary: To evaluate the efficacy of YKYY015 injection in participants with elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) under statin therapy.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Willing to follow the visit schedule and requirements; sign the written informed consent.
2. Body Mass Index (BMI) within the range of 19 to 35 kg/m² (inclusive).
3. On a low-fat diet for ≥4 weeks prior to randomization; agree to maintain stable diet and lifestyle throughout the study.
4. On moderate-to-high intensity statin; eligible for a 4-week 20mg atorvastatin run-in; plan to keep it unchanged (except for safety).
5. Fasting serum LDL-C at screening and run-in (local lab):

   1. ASCVD patients: ≥1.8 mmol/L (≥70 mg/dL);
   2. Others: ≥2.6 mmol/L (≥100 mg/dL).
6. No pregnancy intention; effective contraception; negative serum pregnancy test at screening/run-in if childbearing potential.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known HoFH; or any clinically significant uncontrolled disease that may cause secondary dyslipidemia, confound results, or increase risk (per investigator).
2. Local lab TG \>5.6 mmol/L (500 mg/dL) at screening or run-in; or conditions deemed by the investigator as high risk (e.g., pancreatitis) making the participant unsuitable for enrollment.
3. Positive for HBsAg, HCVAb, HIV antibody, or Treponema pallidum antibody.
4. ALT, AST, ALP, or GGT \>2×ULN, or TBIL \>1.5×ULN at screening or run-in.
5. eGFR \<30 mL/min/1.73m² (CKD-EPI) at screening or run-in.
6. Uncontrolled thyroid dysfunction (exception: hypothyroid on stable replacement ≥28 days with normal TSH, maintaining same dose).
7. TSH \>1.5×ULN or TSH \<0.1 mIU/L at screening or run-in.
8. QT/QTcF interval prolonged: males ≥450 ms, females ≥470 ms at screening or run-in.
9. History of allergic disease or allergic constitution (allergic to ≥2 drugs), or known allergy to study drug components, oligonucleotides, or rescue drugs (e.g., fibrates).
10. Intolerance to subcutaneous injection, or abdominal scarring (e.g., from surgery/burns) or other local conditions affecting subcutaneous administration.
11. Use of PCSK9 monoclonal antibodies (e.g., evolocumab, alirocumab) within 90 days prior to first dose of study drug.
12. Use of siRNA drugs within 6 months, or Inclisiran injection within 1 year prior to first dose.
13. New/dose-adjusted lipid-affecting or weight-loss drugs within 28 days (e.g., steroids, fish oil \>1g/day, red yeast rice, orlistat), except protocol-allowed therapy.
14. History of drug abuse causing physical or psychological dependence.
15. In the 3 months prior to first dose, donated/lost more than 400 mL of blood.
16. Recent severe CV/cerebrovascular disease - NYHA III-IV HF, unstable angina, PVD, severe arrhythmia, MI, stroke, hemorrhage, or revascularization.
17. Uncontrolled HTN (SBP \>160 or DBP \>100 on two antihypertensives) at screening/run-in.
18. Cyclic/non-cyclic hormones (incl. oral contraceptives, HRT, estrogen modulators) within 90 days. Stable non-cyclic oral HRT ≥90 days may be acceptable if continued.
19. Use of drugs or foods contraindicated with atorvastatin (e.g., cyclosporine) within the 5 half-lives before screening or randomization.
20. Malignancy within 5 years (except cured basal cell carcinoma) or currently suspected malignancy.
21. Major surgery within 6 months before screening or during the run-in period, or planned major surgery during the study.
22. Severe psychiatric illness or disorder, including but not limited to schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or major depression requiring medication.
23. Diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus, or poorly controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus \[glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) \>8.5% at screening or run-in\].
24. Participated in another interventional trial (investigational drug/device) within 3 months or 5 half-lives before first dose, or still within effect period of prior intervention.
25. Participants judged by the investigator to have any factors that make them unsuitable for participation in this trial.
